title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging hardening
author: Lena Park
description: This PR implements enforcement and hardening for RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and improves audit logging for KMS-residency-related actions. Motivation: customers in regulated regions need strong guarantees that keys and decrypt operations are constrained to configured regions, and security posture requires richer audit trails for policy enforcement decisions. Changes include enforcement hooks in the RBAC engine, validation in the Private controller and API layer to reject mismatched KMS region requests, expanded audit events for policy evaluations and KMS operations, and a short migration/compatibility shim for existing policies. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated (rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce) enabled in staging for 48h with elevated logging, then progressively enable for canary orgs before global release. Backwards compatibility: default mode remains "audit" (no enforcement) until feature flag enabled; migration tool included to surface policies that will fail enforcement. Testing: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests for KMS lookup+region matching, e2e in private deployment image with local KMS emulator. See linked Linear tasks ENG-8271 and SEC-134 for design notes.

release_notes: Enforceable KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies (feature-flag gated). Improved audit events for KMS policy evaluation. Migration scanner to surface policies incompatible with enforcement.
migration_instructions: Run 'redwood-rbac-scan --output=json' to list policies that will be rejected when enforcement is turned on. Default mode remains audit; enable feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' in private.values when ready. Ensure KMS region config is set in installer values or the controller will fail validation.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests using local KMS emulator, and an e2e that installs private chart with feature flag enabled. CI stabilized by adding emulator startup retry and mocking in select unit tests.
notes_and_risks: Risk: misconfigured policies may cause outages when enforcement toggled on — migration scanner mitigates this. Operational: increased audit volume for policy evaluations; recommend adjusting observability retention or aggregated metrics to avoid SLI noise.
